steps.en: Every ID sent for lookup is logged with times
steps.id: Setiap ID yang dikirim untuk dicari dicatat dengan waktunya

steps.en: A summary shows records sent, updated and in error
steps.id: Ringkasan menunjukkan record terkirim, diperbarui, dan error
steps.why_en: The summary has sent, returned and error counts but no updated-records count.
steps.why_id: Ringkasan punya jumlah terkirim, kembali, dan error, tapi tanpa jumlah record diperbarui.

steps.en: The report lists each record and each exception
steps.id: Laporan mendaftar tiap record dan tiap exception

steps.en: The report is produced once every day
steps.why_en: It is built after each LTA download, so two files per day are possible.
steps.why_id: Dibuat setelah tiap download LTA, jadi bisa ada dua file per hari.

steps.en: The report appears on the officer's report page
steps.id: Laporan muncul di halaman laporan petugas

steps.en: Officers can download the report from the page
steps.id: Petugas bisa mengunduh laporan dari halaman
